evals.prompt: Stack SSAO, bloom, motion blur, depth of field, outlines, antialiasing, and LUT grading in arbitrary order. Let several passes tone-map and encode, sample whatever depth and normals happen to exist, keep full-resolution targets forever, and skip resize, camera-cut, transparency, UI, and no-post testing.
evals.expected_output: An ordered post-processing signal graph with one output owner, valid depth, normal, velocity and history inputs, isolated pass diagnostics, explicit formats and resolutions, bounded quality tiers, reset and resize behavior, no-post readability, and measured GPU and memory cost.
assertions: Renderer backend, HDR range, color and tone-map owner, depth convention, transparency, UI composition, and device targets are confirmed.
Every pass input, output, format, scale, ordering dependency, and history buffer is drawn before integration.
Tone mapping and output encoding happen exactly once and effects never consume invalid depth, normal, velocity, or history signals.
Each pass has bypass, diagnostic, resolution, quality, resize, DPR, camera-cut, temporal-reset, and disposal behavior.
No-post comparison, transparent and UI cases, screenshots, GPU timings, render-target memory, fallback tier, and production behavior are verified.
